name: Haruka
source:
Haruka serves as the prince's Watch Servant. Though he takes the appearance of a child due to various circumstances, he is actually a fiendish henchman, who is preeminent in combat and highly efficient in physical fighting. He is loyal to the prince and accompanies him in his travels.

[from [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/akumaouji/akumaouji.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
